snippet.title: One Castle, Way Too Many Bugs | Roguelike Tower Defense Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 We're Gonna Need More Fireballs is out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037670/Were_Gonna_Need_More_Fireballs/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_description&utm_campaign=fb_trailer_official

Indie roguelike tower defense game in pixel art.

Bugs. More bugs. Drop them, skewer them, blow them up.

▶ All trailers, gameplay and Shorts: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUb_4GHFlRsU

Which tower would you build first? Tell us in the comments!

🔥 We're Gonna Need More Fireballs: a tower defence game about holding one castle against a swarm counted in hundreds of thousands.
